run_multinode_finetune: run multinode AudioMAE finetuning training via submitit on a SLURM cluster with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_trainer_job: submit a Trainer job to the SLURM scheduler using submitit AutoExecutor with GPU and memory parameters
parse_finetune_args: parse command line arguments for multinode finetune jobs including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition settings
setup_trainer_checkpoint: setup a Trainer checkpoint to resume training from a saved checkpoint.pth file on requeue
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments from the submitit JobEnvironment including local rank, global rank, and world size
